decisive_items: clonal amplification product for the γ-chain of the T-cell receptor
atypical lymphocytes with focal areas of epidermotropism
Positive for CD2, CD3, CD4, and CD45RO
response.rationale: R2 (Mycosis Fungoides) is the more specific and complete diagnosis, directly supported by multiple raw spans including pruritic eruptions, dome-shaped nodules, atypical epidermotropic lymphocytes, CD4+ phenotype, and clonal TCR rearrangement. R3 (Cutaneous T-cell lymphoma) is a broader category with only the TCR clonality span as raw support, lacking the specific clinical and histopathologic features that R2 captures.

rejected.why: Less specific and under-supported; only cites TCR clonality, missing the characteristic clinical and histopathologic features that point to Mycosis Fungoides.
